notes.title: Survive or Die release date
notes.content:
We would like to announce to all our fans that Survive or Die will be released on November 16th!

We hope you enjoy our game!

notes.title: New patch for the demo version of the game
notes.content:
Patch fix, improvements in demo version of the game

- bug fixes
- graphics adjustments and optimizations
- optimization of the opening sequence in the prison
- Improved game AI
